Reaction **2** can be carried out by passing the vapour of **X** over hot aluminium oxide.

The product of reaction **2**, $\text{C}_4\text{H}_8$, is actually a mixture of three isomers.

Give the full names of the three isomers formed by reaction **2**.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem:
The reaction of methylpropene, $(\text{CH}_3)_2\text{CCH}_2$, with hydrogen bromide, $\text{HBr}$, produces a mixture of two halogenoalkanes.

One of the halogenoalkanes, 2-bromo-2-methylpropane, is formed as the major product while 1-bromo-2-methylpropane is formed in small quantities.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why 2-bromo-2-methylpropane is the major product of this reaction.
